events.description: Violent clash between protesters wearing yellow vests and riot police in full protective gear, involving pushing, shoving, use of shields, and apparent deployment of crowd-control measures (e.g., possible water cannon or tear gas visible as mist at t=6.5–7.5). The confrontation escalates from standoff to active physical engagement.

Direct physical combat between individuals: police officers and protesters engage in mutual grappling, striking, and shield-bashing; one officer is seen being pushed down or falling at t=4.5–5.0, and multiple close-contact struggles occur.

Sustained violent clash between riot police in full protective gear (helmets, shields, batons) and protesters, many wearing yellow vests, on a Paris street; includes charging, shoving, use of batons, and deployment of tear gas (visible at t=11.5).

Direct physical combat between individual police officers and protesters: officers wielding batons and shields engage in close-quarters shoving and striking; protesters push back or are struck while standing or falling.

A protester is on the ground (kneeling/crouching) while multiple officers surround and appear to strike or press down on them with batons/shields; the individual is in a vulnerable, non-aggressive posture.

Large-scale violent unrest involving a dense crowd of yellow-vested protesters clashing with riot police in Paris; police deploy tear gas and water cannon (visible as white smoke/clouds and high-pressure spray) to disperse the crowd, while officers in full gear advance with shields and batons.

Close-quarters physical confrontation between riot police and protesters: officers in helmets and body armor use batons and shields to push back individuals, with visible shoving, striking motions, and defensive postures from both sides.
Large crowd of protesters in yellow vests engaged in violent unrest with police; tear gas and water cannon deployed, smoke弥漫, and chaotic movement indicating collective violent confrontation.

Close-up frames show individuals in yellow vests physically grappling with police officers near a vehicle amid heavy smoke; one person appears to be pulling or striking another who is on the ground or crouched.

Large crowd of protesters wearing yellow vests engaged in violent unrest with police; tear gas and water cannon deployed, resulting in dense smoke and chaotic movement; multiple individuals are seen falling, crouching, or being subdued amid the smoke and police vehicles.

In frames f3–f11, a person in a yellow vest is on the ground amidst heavy smoke while another individual (likely a police officer, given proximity to police vehicle and uniform elements) appears to be restraining or striking them; the victim is in a vulnerable, prone position with no apparent resistance, consistent with abuse during crowd control.
Multiple individuals in yellow vests are crouched or on the ground amid dense white smoke, suggesting deployment of tear gas or smoke canisters during a protest-related confrontation.

A police water cannon vehicle actively sprays a high-pressure jet of water across a street lined with trees and buildings, dispersing people (some in yellow vests) — characteristic of crowd control during a riot or large-scale protest.

An armored police vehicle advances through a burning barricade made of wooden pallets and metal grates during a street protest; smoke and flames surround the vehicle while uniformed officers are visible in the background.

A group of protesters, many wearing yellow vests, collectively lift and maneuver a large wooden barricade structure in the street, near an active fire; this appears to be coordinated construction or repositioning of a protest barrier.

A group of individuals in yellow vests collectively push and maneuver a large wooden barricade in an urban street, while a fire burns nearby and smoke is present; the scene shows coordinated group action involving obstruction and property damage consistent with riotous behavior.

An armored police vehicle is shown with visible fire and smoke near its front-left wheel area, suggesting it has been targeted during unrest; the vehicle appears stationary or damaged amid the protest environment.

A large group of protesters in yellow vests confronts a line of riot police in full protective gear (helmets, shields, body armor), with raised fists and agitated postures; the standoff is tense and appears to involve physical pressure against the police line, consistent with collective violent unrest.
